title: Walk-through 3 of 5: ARCHER Arisen (camera while aiming, Arisen fight; about 2 minutes)
intro: Needs a trip to a vocation guild first: the ARISEN must be an ARCHER. If you have not done Reset Scripts since the player-mode test, do it now (the Dev HUD must list DirectPawnControl in white). Open ground, no enemies near, full party. Skip with Shift+End if you do not want this one.

steps.text: CAMERA, bow aim as the Arisen: hold aim for 3 seconds. The grey line below should read 'suspended: Aiming' (in the camera mod's own window: AUTO-SUSPENDED (Aiming)). Let go: the camera eases back to your distance. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

expect.label: camera mod suspends while the Archer Arisen aims

steps.text: If the aim camera looked worse than before: untick 'Auto-Suspend While Aiming' in the camera mod and try again, and tell Claude which was better. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)
HANDS OFF: taking control of your main pawn
HANDS OFF: three goblins. Watch the Arisen (Archer) fight on his own.

expect.label: the Archer Arisen attacks or uses a skill on his own
lock-on stays with the played pawn

steps.text: Did he fight sensibly (moved in, attacked, used skills, did not stand still or run off)? Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.dpc: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.info
probes.sel: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.sel_label
probes.holds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.holds or 0) or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.lock_ok:
local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not (D and D.state.active and D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl and D.state.pawn_chara) then return nil end
local c = D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl:get_field('Chara'); return c ~= nil and c:get_address() == D.state.pawn_chara:get_address()
probes.lockfix: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.lock_fixes or 0) or 0
probes.ring:
local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.GuiManager'); local u = gm and gm:get_field('MagicBowReticle'); if not u then return false end
return u:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_DrawSelf') == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0
probes.skills: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.skill_uses or 0
probes.bmode: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.mode
probes.world: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.world
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.binds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.bind and D.R.bind.sig
probes.cam: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and tostring(d.info) or ''
probes.aimsk: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.aim and d.aim.aim_skills or 0
probes.anydead:
local pm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l = pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not l then return false end
for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do local c = l:call('get_Item', i); if c and c:call('get_IsDead') == true then return true end end
return false
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.ajob: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.job
